stress_audit: Shifting the registration by its uncertainty is vacuous here: with no transform, every geometry-dependent conclusion flips under an arbitrary shift. Every row whose conclusion depends on where the Raman region sits is therefore REGISTRATION-LIMITED, not classified. The sr1 row's fused verdict does not depend on registration - it is carried by transport, whose footprint is the channel by definition - so that row is stable.
